1.text: Mose arayisubiza ati “Ariko ntibazanyemera, ntibazanyumvira kuko bazambwira bati ‘Uwiteka ntiyakubonekeye.’ ”

2.text: Uwiteka aramubaza ati “Icyo ufite mu ntoki ni iki?”Aramusubiza ati “Ni inkoni.”

3.text: Aramubwira ati “Yijugunye hasi.” Ayijugunya hasi ihinduka inzoka, Mose arayihunga.

4.text: Uwiteka aramubwira ati “Rambura ukuboko uyifate umurizo.” Arambura ukuboko arayifata, irongera iba inkoni mu ntoki ze.

5.text: Uwiteka ati “Ni ukugira ngo bemere yuko Uwiteka Imana ya ba sekuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, Imana ya Isaka, Imana ya Yakobo, yakubonekeye.”

6.text: Kandi Uwiteka aramubwira ati “Ishyire ikiganza mu gituza.” Yishyira ikiganza mu gituza, agikuyemo kiza cyuzuyeho ibibembe, cyera nka shelegi.

7.text: Aramubwira ati “Cyisubize mu gituza.” Acyisubiza mu gituza, agikuyemo kiza gihwanye n'undi mubiri wose.

8.text: Uwiteka ati “Kandi nibatakwemera ngo bemezwe n'ikimenyetso cya mbere, bazemera icya kabiri.

9.text: Kandi nibaramuka batemejwe n'ibyo bimenyetso byombi, ntibumvire amagambo yawe, uzavome amazi yo mu ruzi uyasuke imusozi, ayo mazi uvomye mu ruzi azahindukira amaraso imusozi.”

10.text: Mose abwira Uwiteka ati “Mwami, na mbere sindi intyoza mu magambo, n'ubu nubwo uvuganye nanjye umugaragu wawe, kuko ntabasha kuvuga vuba, kandi ururimi rwanjye rugatinda.”

11.text: Uwiteka aramubwira ati “Ni nde waremye akanwa k'umuntu? Cyangwa ni nde utera uburagi, cyangwa ubupfamatwi, cyangwa uhumūra, cyangwa uhumisha? Si jye Uwiteka ubikora?

12.text: Nuko none genda, nanjye nzajya mbana n'akanwa kawe, nkwigishe ibyo uvuga.”

13.text: Aramusubiza ati “Mwami ndakwingize, tuma uwo ushaka gutuma.”

14.text: Mose yikongereza uburakari bw'Uwiteka, aramubwira ati “Aroni mwene so Umulewi, ntahari? Nzi yuko ari intyoza kandi aje kugusanganira, nakubona azishimira mu mutima we.

15.text: Nawe uzajye uhora umubwira ushyire amagambo mu kanwa ke, nanjye nzajya mbana n'akanwa kawe n'ake mbigishe ibyo mukora.

16.text: Kandi azajya akubwirira abantu, azakubere akanwa, nawe uzamubera nk'Imana.

17.text: Kandi uzajye witwaza iyo nkoni, ni yo uzakoresha bya bimenyetso.”

18.text: Mose aragenda asubira kwa Yetiro sebukwe aramubwira ati “Ndakwingize, reka nsubire muri bene wacu bari muri Egiputa, menye yuko bakiriho.” Yetiro asubiza Mose ati “Genda amahoro.”

19.text: Uwiteka abwirira Mose i Midiyani ati “Genda usubire muri Egiputa, kuko abantu bose bashakaga kukwica bapfuye.”

20.text: Mose ajyana umugore we n'abana be, abashyira ku ndogobe, asubira mu gihugu cya Egiputa, kandi yitwaza ya nkoni y'Imana.

21.text: Uwiteka abwira Mose ati “Nusubira muri Egiputa ntuzabure gukorera imbere ya Farawo ibitangaza byose nguhaye gukora, ariko nzanangira umutima we ntazareka abantu bagenda.

22.text: Kandi uzabwire Farawo uti ‘Uwiteka aravuze ati: ubwoko bw'Abisirayeli ni umwana wanjye w'impfura,

23.text: kandi narakubwiye nti: rekura umwana wanjye agende ankorere, ariko wanze kumurekura. Nuko rero nzica umwana wawe w'impfura.’ ”

24.text: Bukeye ari mu rugendo, Uwiteka amusanga mu ndaro yarayemo, ashaka kumwica.

25.text: Maze Zipora yenda isarabwayi, akeba umunwa w'icyo umwana we yambariye, awujugunya imbere ya Mose aramubwira ati “Ni ukuri umbereye umukwe uvusha amaraso.”

26.text: Uwiteka aramureka, maze Zipora aramubwira ati “Uri umukwe uvusha amaraso! Gukeba abana ni ko nkwitiye ntyo.”

27.text: Uwiteka abwira Aroni ati “Jya mu butayu usanganirireyo Mose.” Aragenda amusanganirira ku musozi w'Imana, aramusoma.

28.text: Mose abwira Aroni amagambo Uwiteka yamutumye yose, n'ibimenyetso byose yamutegetse gukora.

29.text: Mose na Aroni baragenda, bateranya abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli.

30.text: Aroni ababwira amagambo yose Uwiteka yatumye Mose, akorera bya bimenyetso imbere y'abantu.

31.text: Abantu baremera, bumvise yuko Uwiteka yagendereye Abisirayeli akabona umubabaro wabo, barunama bikubita hasi.
